name: neuCentrIX Banda Aceh
notes: DCD reported Telkom Indonesia launched a neuCentrIX data center in Banda Aceh, ready for commercial operations and serving government services and local ISPs.

name: Biznet Data Center Badung Jimbaran
notes: Biznet's official site lists its Bali data center at Rimba Jimbaran Bali / Karang Mas Estate in Jimbaran, Badung. Public page did not state MW capacity.

name: Nusantara Data Center Bali
notes: Moratelindo's official service page lists Nusantara Data Center Denpasar/Bali; Datacenters.com locates NDC Bali in Denpasar. Capacity not publicly stated.

name: EC71 Bali
notes: Baxtel lists EC71 Bali among Bali colocation data centers. Treated as aggregate evidence; capacity not disclosed.

name: NeutraDC Serpong
notes: NeutraDC's official location page lists Serpong, South Tangerang with up to 14 MW IT load; OCOLO corroborates the Banten location and 14 MW capacity.

name: BDx Technopark BSD CGK2
notes: OCOLO lists BDx Technopark BSD CGK2 at Jalan Raya Serpong, Setu, South Tangerang, Banten with 3.50 MW. Aggregate evidence only.

name: Princeton Digital JB1
notes: Datacenters.com lists Princeton Digital JB1 in Pondok Aren, South Tangerang, Banten; OCOLO lists PDG as one of the Banten providers. Capacity not confirmed.

name: Central Java Provincial Data Center
developer: Central Java Provincial Government / Diskominfo Jateng
notes: Central Java government announced the Semarang provincial data center inauguration on 2023-01-03; Antara corroborates the opening and BSSN listing. Capacity not stated.

name: DCI E2 Surabaya
notes: DCI's official site says E2 Surabaya has 9 MW capacity and was officially inaugurated on 2026-04-06 as its first facility in Eastern Indonesia.

name: NeutraDC Surabaya
notes: NeutraDC's official location page lists its Surabaya facility at Citraland, Lakarsantri with up to 3 MW IT load; OCOLO corroborates 3.00 MW.

name: Nusantara Data Center Surabaya
notes: DataCenterMap and Datacenters.com list Nusantara Data Center Surabaya in East Java/Surabaya. Capacity not publicly confirmed in the available sources.
